acceptance_gates: all T0-4 config JSON/YAML parse and pass unit tests
A5 independent review of task split / leakage / evaluator binding
per-task real applicability evidence (solver_domain/lift_target_reachable/cross_task_response) from M0/M1 REAL_VSPAERO collection; admission PENDING_M0_BY_DESIGN
M0 freeze of family, split, evaluator, K-shot, seeds, endpoints and budget
Lead signs a new authorization/token; Issue #9 R10 token is not reused
preflight 2/2 PASS before any main evaluation; any failure aborts without retry

budget_accounting.design_evaluation: one physical solver start with 7 internal alpha cases; refine_sweeps=0 in T0-4 pilot

dataset_contract.jsonl_layout: one EvaluationRecord per line; dataset_sha256 = sha256(canonical manifest of ordered record_sha values)

ingestion_pipeline: 1. solver/evaluator writes immutable raw under the run dir; never overwrite R1-R10 bytes
2. adapter builds EvaluationRecord with raw_sha, geometry_sha, solver_version, evaluator_id, x12, active_mask, alpha, Sref, L_ref, constraints
3. validate schema, mask, bounds, objective/status, source policy, budget provenance
4. dedupe on (task_fingerprint, evaluator_id, x12, active_mask); same design twice is an error, not a cache hit
5. append record JSONL; compute dataset_sha256 and task split manifest; cache reads counted separately
6. audit_leakage PASS before meta-train; fail-closed otherwise

leakage_control.heldout_task_rule: meta_test tasks never used for meta-train, early stopping, hyper-parameter search, or feature fitting
leakage_control.preflight_exclusion: preflight rows are pipeline verification only and never enter a dataset or statistic
leakage_control.support_query: within task; disjoint records; query labels never visible to adaptation

budget_provenance.rule: charged (budget reservation) and actual (ledger) are separate columns; never overwritten or mixed in one total

objective_semantics.objective_Di_N: dimensionless primary 0.5*CDi(f1)+0.5*CDi(f2); legacy field suffix _N is retained for T0-2 compatibility
objective_semantics.physical_drag_N: reported separately inside constraints as D_i_N = q*Sref(x)*CDi at matched lift; not the meta-learning target

physics_validation_status.REAL_VSPAERO: NOT_VALIDATED only (never upgraded by this pipeline)

status_semantics.INVALID: objective_Di_N must be null; never impute/fabricate an objective
status_semantics.VALID: objective_Di_N must be a finite number; alpha/Sref/L_ref/raw_sha required for REAL sources

task_identity.task_fingerprint: sha256(canonical physical context: mach, altitude_m, lift_reference_N, lift_tol_rel, alpha grid, active_mask, parameters, fixed variables, solver/OpenVSP, solver_config_sha256, reference_frame, x_ref_m, sref_baseline_m2)
